title: Director, FP&A  (Hybrid)
description:

title: Senior Electrical Engineer (On-site)
description:
Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Electrical/Electronics Engineer to support the implementation of selected product and technology upgrades to their Military Combat Vehicle Portfolio.

  • Knowledge of low voltage (28Vdc) power distribution and management (Solid State Power Controller/Programmable Power Controller)

title: Transportation Analyst (On-site)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Transportation Analyst to support traffic operation services at the Transportation Management Center (PA-TMC).
